motion: The camera does not move. A strong wind sweeps across the hillside, flattening the long grass in waves and tugging at the people's coats and hats. The survivors keep walking slowly out of the open blast doors and down the slope, one after another, squinting up at the bright grey sky, one shielding his eyes with his hand. The small grey delivery robot in the foreground rolls steadily away towards the left edge of frame, leading them, its torn bunting flapping hard in the wind and its amber beacon glowing. Every person keeps their shape. The camera does not move.
